get_predict_unit: get a pretrained MLIP prediction unit for a specified model name with optional inference settings and device
get_reference_energies: get atomic or form elemental reference energies for a pretrained model from HuggingFace Hub
pretrained_checkpoint_path_from_name: download and return the local checkpoint path for a pretrained model by name
review_HuggingFaceCheckpoint: review the HuggingFaceCheckpoint dataclass that stores model filename, repo ID, subfolder, and revision metadata
review_PretrainedModels: review the PretrainedModels dataclass that holds a dictionary of named HuggingFaceCheckpoint entries
